The Dancer acknowledges that MyDancr is not a security service, emergency-response provider, transportation provider, employer, or operator of any club or venue. For any immediate threat or safety emergency, the Dancer must contact 911, law enforcement, appropriate emergency services, and/or club security. MyDancr support is not an emergency service and does not monitor reports in real time.

The Dancer is responsible for making personal safety and transportation decisions while traveling to a club, entering or remaining at a club, working or performing at a club, leaving a club, and traveling home or to any other destination. ELIGIBILITY AND TRUTHFUL IDENTITY.

The Dancer represents that the Dancer is at least 18, is the person operating the account, has legal capacity, and may lawfully work and publish the submitted content. The dancer must provide accurate stage identity and city information and must not use another person's documents, likeness, stage identity, or account. A stage name may be public; any legal identity collected independently by a club, tax authority, or other provider is governed by that relationship and applicable law.

The Dancer must maintain all local work cards, entertainer licenses, permits, immigration/work authorization, and club requirements. A MyDancr badge or affiliation does not replace government or club verification.

PROFILE APPROVAL AND CLUB AFFILIATIONS.

Before the profile becomes public, the Dancer must make the required eligibility and truthful-account representations, complete the required profile fields, obtain approval of required media, and submit the profile. MyDancr alone decides whether the profile is eligible for publication under its account, profile, media, visibility, and safety rules. A club does not approve the Dancer's profile or affiliation. A club affiliation is a separate status established by a validated dressing-room NFC tap and is not a general identity, age, employment, licensing, or safety guarantee.

An affiliation is established automatically when MyDancr validates the Dancer's intentional tap on the club's official dressing-room NFC tag; no club representative approval or confirmation is required. An authorized club user may remove that affiliation through the venue dashboard. The Dancer may post a club-specific shift or use Working Now at a club only while the applicable NFC-established affiliation is active and must promptly correct an inaccurate schedule or notify MyDancr of an inaccurate affiliation.

PUBLIC PROFILE AND SCHEDULE VISIBILITY.

When you publish your profile or schedule, you authorize public display of your stage name, city, approved media, public social links, club affiliations, posted shifts, and Working Now status, as applicable. This information can reveal where you work and when you expect to be there. Public information may be copied or indexed by others. Available profile and schedule controls let you change what MyDancr displays, but MyDancr cannot guarantee removal of copies independently retained by third parties.

WORKING NOW AND NFC PRESENCE EVENTS.

Working Now requires an intentional dressing-room NFC tap validated by MyDancr. The Dancer authorizes collection of the club, time of the event, browser or device information, IP address, the applicable NFC tag, and information reasonably necessary to validate the event, operate the time window, and prevent fraud. The Dancer may not share or copy a tag, simulate a tap, use automation, or ask another person to check in.

Working Now is time-limited and does not promise that the Dancer remains continuously on premises or is available to any customer. The Dancer should end an inaccurate status through available controls and notify support of a malfunction.

NFC AND TECHNICAL INTEGRITY.

The Dancer may not copy, move, alter, obscure, damage, replace, emulate, relay, or misuse an NFC tag; simulate a tap; falsify redemption or verification information; gain unauthorized access; introduce malicious code; scrape or interfere with the Service; or access data outside their authorized permissions.

NFC ASSURANCE.

NFC tags are assigned by purpose and club. A validated tap on an official dressing-room tag establishes the Dancer's affiliation and can support time-limited Working Now presence; cashier tags support deal verification. MyDancr's technical validation of the NFC event is required, but no club representative approval is required. Tags should be installed in controlled areas and replaced if lost, copied, or compromised. MyDancr does not use geofences or continuous or background location tracking for these functions. The applicable intentional NFC tap is the sole in-club verification event.
